records.Checks / Guidance: Check approved isolation/interlocks; inspect mechanical obstruction, rope/pulley/carriage, track/rail, coupling and gearbox.
Check drive, coupling, gearbox, bearings, roller seizure/alignment and lubrication.
Check chain tension/alignment, sprocket condition, bearing/gearbox, obstruction and lubrication.
Check tyre wear/damage, coupling, roller alignment, bearing/gearbox and fastening.
Check hydraulic pressure/pilot pressure, valve/solenoid status, limit switches, cylinder leakage, accumulator/check valves; follow approved emergency procedure.
Check suction/discharge, seal, bearing, coupling/alignment, cooler/piping and standby readiness.
Check lubrication path/nozzles, pump/pressure/flow and blocked nozzles; replace defective nozzles as required.
Check blade gap/condition, crank alignment, pinch-roll centering, billet approach/alignment, guides, coupling and gearbox.
Check rollers/transfer mechanism, stops/guides, drive/coupling, alignment and obstruction.
